name: stress
prompts: show me every account, and under each one its transactions grouped by month with a running balance
which of my subscriptions went up in price this year, and by how much each
let me split last week's grocery charge between me and two other people, then send them each a request

show anything unusual in my spending
let me edit the category on any transaction inline, and keep a running total per category as I do
give me one screen I could show my accountant
